Class UniversityStudent

java.lang.Object
Student
UniversityStudent
public class UniversityStudent extends Student
The UniversityStudent class represents a concrete implementation of the abstract Student class. It models a university-level student with personal, academic, and experiential attributes inherited from Student. Additional behaviors specific to university students are included, such as calculating connection strength with other students.

This class is intended for use in systems involving student matching, referral networks, roommate assignments, or graph-based social modeling.
